messages:
maria: Quick follow-up on the cert rotation handshake for private VPC peering — I'm worried about a small window where control-plane certs rotate out-of-sync and relays start rejecting. Thoughts?
kevin: yeah this was flagged in the spike — peered controlplanes don't share a single CA, so rotations can fail hard.
sam: could we rely on cross-signed CAs for the transition? new CA signs old certs for X days while we rotate.
arjun: cross-signing helps but ops complexity increases. also need a way to validate chain without pulling full trust store over the peering.
lia: what about a short-lived rotation protocol: 1) publish new cert metadata to S3-like store in customer VPC 2) confirm fetch 3) switch. lightweight fetch + signer proof.
maria: we don't want to assume customer S3. idea: implement cert-announcement over our peering tunnel using an authenticated signed manifest. agent pushes manifest to controlplane-relay endpoint.
kevin: manifest format sketch:
```
{ "tenant": "acme", "cert_sha256": "...", "valid_from": 167..., "signed_by": "rotator@redwood" }
```
relay verifies signature, downloads cert via mTLS fetch.
sam: fallback if fetch fails? still need to avoid 503s.
arjun: fallback plan: keep old cert valid for TTL+grace window; route degraded traffic to host-level proxy that accepts both chains during window.
lia: operationally we need: metrics for manifest-delivery latency, a canary rollout (1% tenants), and an operator command to force revert.
maria: open questions: cross-account KMS for signing? or use centralized rotator with HSM + auditable logs.
kevin: centralized rotator simpler, plus per-tenant audit events stored in customer project. use HSM-backed signing keys. we need a migration script to backfill current certs into rotator DB.
sam: can we simulate at scale? I'd like a "chaos" job that rotates certs on a mirror controlplane and runs connectivity probe.
lia: deploy-bot: New job created: cert-rotation-staging-sim (queued) :rocket:
maria: next steps: I'll draft an RFC for manifest protocol + rotator API, include rollback playbook. I'll stub the manifest verifier in the agent during spike.
arjun: +1. also add a TTL policy and a metric to detect "mixed-chain" spikes so SRE can alert early.
kevin: thanks — tagging @security for KMS/HSM review.
sam: thanks all, will help with the chaos test and the operator tooling.
maria: cool — will post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
